name: What factors determine the cost to paint a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost to paint a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The overall cost is primarily determined by wall condition, square footage, ceiling height, and required primer types. A foreclosure with sound drywall and minor scuffs costs significantly less than one requiring extensive patching, mold remediation prep, or full-coverage shellac primer for heavy smoke or pet odors. Trim details, door condition, and whether kitchen cabinets or baseboards need repainting also affect the total scope. During an initial walk-through, our owner assesses the necessary prep work and provides a comprehensive estimate outlining surface repairs alongside finish coats so you have clear price transparency before work starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost factors include property square footage, the volume of drywall repairs needed, trim and door condition, and whether specialized stain- or odor-blocking primers are required.
